_about: Each question's answer is verifiably present in the FULL corpus. `evidence` is a regex that must still match the (possibly compressed) context for the answer to be recoverable at all (deterministic retention check). `answer` is a regex applied to an LLM's reply (QA accuracy check). Questions were written before any compression was run. Questions marked paraphrase:true deliberately avoid the literal keywords of their evidence line, to test lexical-filter failure modes.
